source: Use zero-based rows 2 and 3 of the official drawer initialization file at the revision and SHA256 in drawer/protocol.json. Run both official tasks from each same drawer reset. The stove task's own layout IDs do not identify these states.
gate: Before any continuation, collect both standalone tasks with seeds 0 and 1 in each of two freshly loaded models. Drawer needs moving-drawer contact and open at 160. Stove needs moving-button contact and on at 300. Report all layouts, seeds and blocks at both deadlines if applicable. A layout needs at least one success for each task. Use every qualifying naturally opened, stove-off drawer endpoint at 160 from a competent layout, including contact and noncontact endpoints. Pair continuation block b with drawer gate block b. No search or endpoint replacement.
transfer: Always apply the original 60-control preparation and same joint target rule, gains and limits. Score every scheduled attempt, including preparation/scene drift failures. Do not retune the motion, timing, layouts or endpoints. Recheck the original scene and posture criteria for every endpoint individually. Report physical tolerance failures alongside stove outcomes.
outcomes: From the drawer endpoint score switch-on at total control 160 and 300, first contact with the moving switch, ever-on and open drawer. Eight matched post-drawer RNG streams per natural endpoint and treatment. Reverse condition order on the second block. Compare paired successes and losses per layout and block, and after equal policy exposure (100/240 active controls). Keep totals per physical endpoint and expose repeated identical state hashes.
decision: Assess the 15 s advantage over both immediate and wait separately in each of the two model blocks for each layout; also report 8 s separately. A strict two-layout transfer of the qualified posture requires both competence gates, all included pose/wait preparations passing the frozen physical limits, and a positive 15 s difference over each control in each block of both layouts. If an endpoint fails preparation, still score its fixed maneuver as applied, identify the physical reason, and report qualified-only counts separately.
